patthana11.17:1.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca… hetuyā tiṃsa.
patthana11.17:2.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nadukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca… hetuyā tiṃsa.
patthana11.17:3.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naadukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca… hetuyā tiṃsa.
patthana11.17:4.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ navipākaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ navipākadhammadhammaṃ paṭicca… hetuyā tiṃsa.
patthana11.17:10.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nasaṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca… hetuyā tiṃsa.
patthana11.17:12.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naasaṃkiliṭṭhaasaṃkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca… hetuyā tiṃsa.
patthana11.17:16.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ napītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nasukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naupekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.17:17.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nadassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.17:18.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nanevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.17:19.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nadassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.17:20.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nanevadassanena nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….

patthana11.17:23.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nasekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naasekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.17:26.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ namahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naappamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.17:27.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naparittārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ namahaggatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naappamāṇārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.17:32.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ namicchattaniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nasammattaniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.17:34.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ namaggārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ namaggahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ namaggādhipatiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.17:35.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naanuppannaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nauppādiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.17:36.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naatītaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naanāgataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.17:38.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naatītārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naanāgatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ napaccuppannārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.17:40.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naajjhattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nabahiddhā dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana11.17:42.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naajjhattārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasanidassanasappaṭigho naajjhattārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ naajjhattārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naanidassanasappaṭigho naajjhattārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.

patthana11.17:47.1: Nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nabahiddhārammaṇañca naanidassanaappaṭighaṃ nabahiddhārammaṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nasanidassanasappaṭigho nabahiddhārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… cha.
patthana11.17:48.1: Naanidassanasappaṭighaṃ nabahiddhārammaṇañca naanidassanaappaṭighaṃ nabahiddhārammaṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca nasanidassanasappaṭigho nabahiddhārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… cha. (Saṃkhittaṃ.)
patthana11.17:49.1: Hetuyā tiṃsa, ārammaṇe nava…pe… avigate tiṃsa.
patthana11.17:50.1: (Sahajātavārepi paccayavārepi nissayavārepi saṃsaṭṭhavārepi sampayuttavārepi pañhāvārepi vitthāro.) Dhammapaccanīye tikatikapaṭṭhānaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
